description: This file implements a native CPU thread emulation module for a simulator, managing thread creation, swapping, aborting, and cleanup using POSIX pthreads. It provides functions for initializing, cleaning up, and controlling thread execution within a simulated environment, including handling thread states and synchronization.

methods.name: nct_exit_and_cleanup
methods.description: Handles thread cleanup by unlocking mutex, detaching thread, and exiting.

methods.name: ttable_get_element
methods.description: Retrieves a thread table element by index, handling table expansion if needed.

methods.name: ttable_get_empty_slot
methods.description: Finds an available slot in the thread table, expanding the table if necessary.

methods.name: nct_wait_until_allowed
methods.description: Blocks a thread until it is allowed to run based on the current thread control state.

methods.name: nct_let_run
methods.description: Sets the next thread to run and broadcasts condition to wake waiting threads.

methods.name: abort_tail
methods.description: Performs cleanup for a thread marked for aborting.

methods.name: nct_thread_starter
methods.description: Entry point for new pthreads, initializes thread execution and waits for permission to run.
